_meta.description: Navigate to ElevenLabs API keys settings and read the keys table: name, masked key suffix, created date, enabled state.

auth.note: Requires an active elevenlabs.io login session in the connected Chrome (ChromeMain debug profile). Uses open_tab so it never hijacks the active tab.

_meta.selectorNotes: Next.js app. Keys table lives at /app/developers/api-keys, headers: Name | Key | Created | Enabled | (blank, kebab menu column). Key values are always masked in the DOM (bullet chars + last 4 chars) — the relay's generic 'read' action never sees a live secret here, which is why this recipe is safe to run unattended. 'Create Key' button text is stable. Each row's LAST column holds a button whose accessible text is literally 'Open menu' (a kebab/more-actions control) — do NOT confuse it with the 'Enabled' column's toggle switch, which is a separate button one column to the left with no text content (see 02-create-api-key.payload.json and the site README for the incident that taught us this).

chain.note: New tab, read-only. NEVER navigate the active tab.

Read the keys table (name/masked-suffix/created/enabled) and button labels. IMPORTANT: never log or report a full key value — ElevenLabs always masks it in this table, but if a future redesign ever shows one in the clear, stop and do not print it.
